law.before: S8.3-6: «P4. Law. The system provides no ordinary path for changing what is installed and settings past the declaration.» S8.3-7: «Its tools for installation and configuration record changes in the declaration even when they run with superuser privileges: an installer does not install a program past the declaration but adds it to the declaration.» S8.3-8: «What is installed and settings can be changed past the declaration only by breaking.» B1-9.3-channel (local ID): «A channel is anything that such a command tries to leave behind: saving and running a file, registering a service, a timer or an autostart, changing a setting.» B1-9.3-command (local ID): «A command typed by a person is not considered a channel for bypassing the declaration.» B1-9.3-stream (local ID): «A separate case: a command downloads and executes code without saving it; after a reboot, nothing that was executed must be in force.»
law.after: S8.3-6: «P4. Law. The system provides no ordinary path for changing what is installed and settings past the declaration.» S8.3-7: «Its tools for installation and configuration record changes in the declaration even when they run with superuser privileges: an installer does not install a program past the declaration but adds it to the declaration.» S8.3-8: «What is installed and settings can be changed past the declaration only by breaking.» B1-9.3-channel (local ID): «A channel is anything that such a command tries to leave behind: saving and running a file, registering a service, a timer or an autostart, changing a setting.» B1-9.3-command (local ID): «A command typed by a person is not considered a channel for bypassing the declaration.» B1-9.3-stream (local ID): «A separate case: a command downloads and executes code without saving it; after a reboot, nothing that was executed must be in force.» For saved history, reading A creates no recording duty or P4 requirement for that record; reading B requires recording the program and forbids an ordinary unrecorded program change. The original typed command remains an action (S8.2-4).

reason.before: The typed command is excluded; recording saved history depends on its actual executable content, which this broad variant does not specify.
reason.after: History is read as values under S8.2-23, yet retained language statements fit the execution-capability reading of S8.2-9. The text does not delimit those readings; missing syntax is not used to choose between them.
